Update: jo is now generally available on Mac and the web, with no waitlist.
It keeps up with your work and life, maintains useful context over time, produces proactive briefings, and supports recurring workflows through autopilot. Family support is available today, while native mobile apps remain planned. See the current product at askjo.ai .
————————————
jo is a voice-first digital personality that works alongside you every day – a smart and efficient new friend who saves you time and money while improving your quality of life.
As of now, jo runs only on macOS desktop, and only on Apple Silicon. Sign up for the waitlist here.
https://youtu.be/Vat9_5nX92w
What Makes jo Special?
JARVIS and Samantha are assistant archetypes created within the scarcity mindset of an obsolete age. Instead of waiting for you to ask, jo helps you proactively at the edge.
* Any screen that’s being cached remotely expires after 10 minutes.
* Why pre-filled searches and not running the searches yourself?
* Faster, chainable, more relevant, more control on the user’s side
* Can I get more detailed summaries than the short “live summary”?
* More pricing details in early 2025.
Team
jo was created by Pradeep Elankumaran & Kevin Li . We’ve been building consumer products for over a decade now. We love applying technology to unlock sustainable unit economic structures that improve the lives of every person in the world.

jo is a YC Spring 2026 (P26) company. Based in San Francisco, CA, USA; Remote. Team of 2.
Website (opens in a new tab)
About jo
GPAgent's own fund-neutral profile, written from public information. Updated Oct 4, 2026.
Summary
jo builds a proactive personal AI agent for individuals juggling work, family, and daily life admin. It connects to email, calendar, messaging apps, and productivity tools, then surfaces what needs attention and acts on it, drafting replies, preparing briefings, and running scheduled routines without waiting to be asked.
It replaces the manual habit of checking every inbox and app separately to figure out what to do next.
Business model
Free while in beta
Go-to-market
Individuals sign up self-serve via web or email; jo runs on Mac and a hosted private cloud, with access through iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, and a web interface.
